gen-luckiest-guy-gf-port-lligat-sans: Loud and cheerful, with thick ink that looks poured rather than drawn. Luckiest Guy shouts in round, unswelling bowls while Port Lligat Sans tucks its tightly packed letters underneath and lets the heading do the talking.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-recursive: The body text reads approachable and modern, with a tall mean line. Recursive keeps that friendliness beside Luckiest Guy, whose loud poured-ink heading makes the gap between display and text the pair's best trick.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-secular-one: Secular One reads dense and modern, with a heavy midsection. Luckiest Guy brings the cheer up top, and over a full page the body keeps a steady, unmodulated line that never gets fussy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-truculenta: Luckiest Guy sets its ink down thick and loud. Truculenta packs compact lines with a tall x-height and short ascenders, and that tight fit under a shouting heading is what makes the pair click.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-voces: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy draws round bowls with no swelling at the stroke ends. But Voces does the quieter work, built tall in the lowercase, its stems and hairlines close in ratio.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough reads big, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Luckiest Guy shouts over it with thick poured ink, and that shared largeness of scale is what ties the two together.
gen-luckiest-guy-plus-jakarta-sans: Cheerful and loud: Luckiest Guy pours thick ink with a high mean line. Plus Jakarta Sans steps in with monoline strokes and curve endings kept well apart, at a moderate lowercase height that lets the heading tower.
gen-luckiest-guy-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk has open, breathing counters and a ribbon of constant width forming each glyph, giving the text a geometric steadiness. Luckiest Guy earns its keep big and brief, up top.
gen-megrim-fs-chillax: Angular and futuristic, Megrim holds every stroke ending to one measured thickness. Chillax, a relaxed sans-serif with pen-lifted, unfinished curves, loosens things up beneath it, so the whole page feels both precise and easygoing.
gen-megrim-fs-spline-sans: Sharp and futuristic, Megrim stands tall on a high x-height line. And Spline Sans takes a moderate lowercase height, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, for a friendly contemporary counterweight.
